how_pulled: gh api repos/RezaSbu/Dubai-Tourism-Data-Analysis-/contents/ ; for f in <6 csvs> README.md: curl -sL -o $f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RezaSbu/Dubai-Tourism-Data-Analysis-/HEAD/$f ; python pandas describe
full_dataset_size: Whole repo is ~165 KB: 19 CSVs (the 6 pulled here plus 12 quarterly e-permit/e-ticketing files 2022-06..2023-09, each 0.3-8 KB), one notebook (119 KB) and a 107 KB PDF report. Pulling everything is a single depth-1 clone; no larger version exists in the repo. The underlying Dubai DET open-data portal series are longer.
description: Six CSV exports in Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism (DET) open-data format, committed by a student EDA project: a monthly overseas visitor count for Dubai (2014-2023, 117 months, gaps in 2016-2019 and 2020 H1), two months (May-Jun 2024) of hotel establishment performance (hotel and room counts by star class, occupancy 79%/67%, ADR AED 444/357, RevPAR), May-Jun 2024 overnight visitors by region and top-20 source market, annual visitor counts by nationality 2016-2022, and annual per-source-market demographics 2016-2023 (age, gender, length of stay, visit purpose). Grain is monthly-by-market or annual-by-nationality; the source is DET's Dubai Pulse portal, re-exported here. An ABNB analyst would use the monthly overseas visitor series as a Gulf/EMEA inbound demand check and the source-market table for origin mix (India, Saudi, UK, Russia, China), but the hotel-KPI and regional splits are only two months long, so this repo is a format reference rather than a usable panel; the full series must come from the DET portal.
issues: No licence in the repo (license: null) and the data are DET/Dubai Pulse exports whose terms are not stated; a human must confirm reuse. Hotel_Establishment_Performance and the by-region/by-source-market tables contain only May and June 2024 (2, 18, 40 rows), far short of the ~2022-2024 monthly panel implied by the job card. The monthly overseas series has holes (2016-05..2016-10, 2017-2019 partly, 2020 H1) and unsorted rows with float-valued counts, suggesting a derived/estimated field (dt_date_srgt surrogate key). Date formats are inconsistent across files (DD-MM-YYYY in the region file, YYYY-MM-DD elsewhere). E-permit/e-ticketing files, the notebook and the PDF were skipped per plan.
